source.title: backend: implement database backup snapshot automation and point-in-time recovery health checks

labels.name: Stellar Wave
labels.description: Issues in the Stellar wave program

source.body:
## Problem
The backend database stores critical merchant billing records, scheduled subscriptions, and webhook audit logs. Operators currently have no automated health check monitoring database backup recency and replication lag.

## Task
Implement backup verification and replication health checks in `apps/backend/`:

1. **Replication Monitor**: Check primary-to-replica WAL replication lag and report errors if lag exceeds 60 seconds.
2. **Snapshot Verification Script**: Automated script verifying that the daily automated snapshot exists and is non-empty.
3. **Health Check Endpoint**: Expose `/api/health/storage` reporting database connection count, backup status, and replication delay.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Health endpoint returns status 200 with JSON metrics when healthy
- [ ] Returns HTTP 503 if replication lag is critical or connection pool is exhausted
- [ ] Unit tests cover health check responses under normal and degraded conditions
- [ ] `npm test` passes in `apps/backend`

## Getting started
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Orbit-xyz/Orbit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Run:
```bash
cd apps/backend && npm test
```
